description: Multi-system cascading failure at Site S003 — chiller plant, AHU, fire suppression, and electrical switchgear faults over 72 hours. Large evidence pack designed to exceed single-pass analysis budget.

evidence_files.description: 480 chiller plant alarms over 72 hours across 3 chillers
320 AHU alarms across 8 air handling units
150 electrical fault alarms including switchgear and UPS
85 fire panel events including suppression triggers
5-minute interval sensor readings for 3 chillers over 72 hours (2592 rows)
5-minute interval readings for 8 AHUs over 72 hours (6912 rows)
1-minute interval power readings from 6 meters over 72 hours (25920 rows)
47 occupant comfort complaints with zone and timestamp
18 months of maintenance records for all affected systems
15-page contractor investigation report with root cause analysis
